Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in Sugar Land, Texas, and was turning left at an
intersection when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through the
same intersection. Upon arrival, I observed that the damage to Driver 1's vehicle was largely consistent with the angle
and force of the impact described by both drivers. Driver 2 stated, without hesitation, that the collision occurred just as
Driver 1 described it, and two inedpendent witnesses gave statements that matched this account. Scene photographs
taken at the time support the same sequence of events. A Passenger was also present in Driver 1's vehicle and was
confirmed by both witnesses and responding officers. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee, which I noted is
consistent with the way the driver's side door and footwell were deformed during the collision. No prior damage to the
vehicle was known to any patry at the scene. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the
vehicle.
